page.layout: One printed page, page 282. Running head at top centre. One main text column with a narrow left margin holding small, heavily damaged notes; the right margin is empty. Section heading "Magistratus majores," centred between two paragraphs. Catchword "regi" at the lower right. Faint bleed-through and stains at the bottom left.

main_text.p: inter se, sed æmuli mitterentur, quò & diligentius & fidelius expedirent, quod in mandatis habebant: quod sæpe reipublicæ magno bono traditur fuisse. Idem utplurimum observatum in iis, qui regi aut duci in bellum eunti, ut à consilio ipsi essent, adjungebantur, quos alienis ab ipso animis, quàm amicitiâ devinctos esse maluerunt.

Nunc ad magistratus majores, partem civitatis primariam, de quibus paucula modò ante dicta, rursum me verto. Reges, ut dixi, binos in civitate reliquit Lycurgus, dignitate quidem & honoribus eximios, sed potestate solitâ pene exutos.[illegible, ~3 letters] Liberi horum, qui in spem regni suscipiebantur, non omnibus educationis legibus, quibus cæteri, erant subjecti, sed in nonnullis statu regii quædam habebatur ratio: quanquàm & hæc severa omnia, & ad gravitatem compositâ, atque istuc dicta, ut à primâ pueritiâ prompte parere legibus, parvoque contenti esse, [illegible, ~6 letters] um & frigus, famem & sitim ferre, [illegible, ~4 letters] ra & difficilia pati addiscerent; in [illegible, ~5 letters] ni denique vitâ justitiam colere, & [illegible, ~4 letters] feveritatem magis quàm ad facilitatem se comparare assuescerent. Mortuo

page.notes: Left margin is largely illegible: small fragments ("n.", "ꝑ", "ni", "ra", "um") are cut or hidden by the notes and show-through, so the marginal notes beside the lines "ut à prima pueritia" through "feveritatem" could not be read and are marked as illegible. Words hidden at line ends in the left margin are marked where the damage falls. The bottom-left stains ("IHE", "3h", "uhhu") are show-through or stains and were left out. No gathering signature is visible. The heading "Magistratus majores," is set in italic and centred, and is treated as a level 2 heading.
